name: DHC Software Co.,Ltd.
summary: DHC Software Co., Ltd., founded in 2001 and headquartered in Beijing, China, provides a comprehensive suite of software solutions, information technology services, and computer system integration across the country. The company, which was formerly known as Beijing Donghua Hechuang Digital Technology Co., Ltd., offers a diverse portfolio of applications and platforms. Their product range includes specialized digital information systems for hospitals, medical insurance payment processing, and smart health service platforms. They also develop advanced solutions for the financial sector, such as commercial banking integration and supply chain finance platforms. Furthermore, DHC offers cutting-edge tools like smart city "super brain" systems, intelligent logistics platforms, big data platforms, and budget management platforms. Beyond software development, the company delivers extensive IT services, encompassing the operation and maintenance of information systems, construction of big data platforms and exchanges, cloud computing implementation, and network engineering. Their expertise also extends to data center management, including storage, disaster recovery, network and information security, building intelligence, and video conferencing solutions. Additionally, DHC supplies various network software and hardware products, with a focus on operational management and security.
